content: द्वीपः, -पम् [द्विर्गता द्वयोर्दिशोर्वा गता आपो यत्र; द्वि-अप्, अप ईप्] .²1 An island. .²2 A place of refuge, shelter, protection. .²3 A division of the terrestrial world; (the number of these divisions varies according to different authorities, being four, seven, nine or thirteen, all situated round the mountain Meru like the petals of a lotus flower, and each being separated from the other by a distinct ocean). [In <ls>N. 1. 5</ls> the Dvīpas are said to be eighteen; but seven appears to be the usual number:-- जम्बु, प्लक्ष, शाल्मलि, कुश, क्रौञ्च, शाक and पुष्कर; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Bhāg. 5. 1. 32</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 65</ls>; and पुरा सप्तदीपां जयति वसुधामप्रतिरथः <ls>Ś. 7. 33</ls>. The central one is जम्बुद्वीप in which is included भरतखण्ड or India.] .{@-पम्@} The skin of a tiger.
